title: 第3章 第二个徒弟第4章 九霄云雷剑法
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
寂月算是近水楼台先得月了。
明年那些宗门来收徒的时候，就寂琳那单系灵根，肯定是会被那些宗门疯抢的。
但是没办法，谁叫她是姐姐呢。
想到这里，寂月忍不住揉了揉寂琳的小脑袋。
“爹，娘，你们也看到了，我有修行的天赋。小妹的资质不错，所以我打算带着她一起离开。”
修仙的第一步，斩尘缘。
即便没有任务时限，她也是会离开这里的，毕竟修士的寿命比普通人长的多。
寂小哥没有修行天分，所以她无法带着他离开。
这样也好，留他一人在家，也可以照顾父母。
至于这养育之恩，寂月打算之后再偿还，毕竟她现在只是一个穷鬼。
“你们要走啊？”寂母愣住了，看着两个女儿的眼神中带着不舍。
但是随即又了然地点点头，既然要修仙，那肯定跟他们这些凡人不同路的。
“爹，娘，你们放心，等我们修得成果后，定然会回来看望你们的。”
寂月转过头，又看向寂小哥，原主的弟弟，“小晨，爹娘就交给你照顾了。”
寂晨不舍地点点头，“放心吧，阿姐，我会照顾好爹娘的。”
尽管内心十分的羡慕，但他也知道，自此他们姐弟算是分道扬镳了。
寂月和寂琳是第二天才离开的。
寂月和寂琳离开前给爹娘磕了三个响头。
而之后，村子里也有了流言。

寂家的傻闺女得了天大的机缘，不仅被仙长看中收为徒弟，还带着小妹一起修仙去了。
寂家有了一个隐形的靠山。
即便无人能够查证，谁也不敢冒这个险。
但谁又能知道，寂月根本就没有师门，并且她还得自己创造师门。
按照系统给的地图，她带着唯一的徒弟，也是她的亲妹妹，朝着灵气充足的方向而去。
一年的时间，要收四个徒弟，还得符合系统的要求。
“系统，我能换个任务不？”
寂月觉得这任务比登天还难。
她要是一个绝世高手，而且很有名气的话，弟子什么的，自己就跑过来了。
但她只是一个才引气入体的小废物。
【任务不可更改！】
“切，小气！”
寂月嘟囔了一下，随后去看寂琳，见对方盘腿坐在大石头上修炼着【乾坤引灵真经】，心里只觉得欣慰。
看来系统是要她走装逼流啊。
一天的时间，寂琳引气入体成功，随后就是冲击炼气期。
content_en:
;;
Jiyue is the first to get the moon near the water and the tower.
When those sects come to recruit disciples next year, Ji Lin's single spiritual root will definitely be snapped up by those sects.
But there is no way, who calls her a sister.
Thinking of this, Jiyue couldn't help but rub Jilin's little head.
"Father, mother, you have also seen that I have the talent for cultivation. My younger sister has good qualifications, so I plan to take her away with me."
The first step in cultivating immortality is to cut off the fate of the world.
Even if there is no mission time limit, she will leave here. After all, the life span of monks is much longer than that of ordinary people.
Brother Ji has no talent for cultivation, so she cannot take him away.
That's fine. He can be left alone at home and take care of his parents.
As for the kindness of raising her, Jiyue plans to repay it later. After all, she is just a poor girl now.
"Are you leaving?" Ji's mother was stunned, looking at her two daughters with reluctance in her eyes.
But then he nodded clearly, since he wanted to cultivate immortality, he must be on a different path from mortals like them.
"Father, mother, don't worry, we will definitely come back to visit you after we achieve results."
Ji Yue turned her head and looked at Brother Ji, the original owner's younger brother, "Xiao Chen, I will leave my parents to you to take care of."
Jichen nodded reluctantly, "Don't worry, sister, I will take good care of my parents."
Although he was very envious in his heart, he also knew that their siblings had parted ways since then.
Jiyue and Jilin left only the next day.
Jiyue and Jilin kowtowed to their parents three times before leaving.
After that, there were rumors in the village.
The silly girl of the Ji family got a great opportunity. Not only was she accepted by the immortal chief as her disciple, but she also took her little sister to cultivate immortality with her.
The Ji family has an invisible backer.
Even if no one can verify it, no one dares to take the risk.
But who could have known that Jiyue didn't have a master at all, and she had to create a master herself.
According to the map given by the system, she took her only apprentice, who was also her biological sister, towards the direction with sufficient spiritual energy.
In one year, four apprentices must be accepted, and they must meet the requirements of the system.
"System, can I change the task?"
Jiyue felt that this task was more difficult than climbing to the sky.
If she were a peerless master and famous, her disciples would come over by herself.
But she was just a little waste who just introduced Qi into her body.
[The task cannot be changed! 】
"Tch, stingy!"
Jiyue muttered, then went to see Jilin, and saw Jilin sitting cross-legged on a big stone practicing the [Qiankun Lingling Sutra], and she felt happy in her heart.
It seems that the system wants her to act cool.
In one day, Ji Lin successfully introduced Qi into her body, and then came the Qi refining period.
